definitions.weighted_employed_up_to_20_people: Employed persons whose reported work/business/enterprise size is up to 20 persons (P512A=1).
definitions.weighted_employed_employer_registered_su: Employed persons reporting the business/enterprise as registered with SUNAT (P510A1=1 or 2).
definitions.weighted_employed_employer_not_registere: Employed persons reporting the business/enterprise as not registered/no RUC (P510A1=3).

limitation: Persons employed by residence department; not firms or jobs located in the department. Registration and size are respondent reports and do not define a legal microenterprise universe.
